provides.port: api (projection in, command out, receipt back)
door socket (the Gateway for doors that hold no secret, over the data home's user-only socket)

owns: the data home's files: work material bytes, thread projections, unsent drafts, viewer preferences

the vault of the home's secrets (keys/vault.json: the cluster's passwords and credentials' master key, sealed under a data key wrapped by Electron safeStorage, a system-store wrapping key, or explicit plaintext); keys/system-id is the system account's nonsecret identity and keys/system-protected records protection intent; the system store holds that account's wrapping key; credentials/ holds sealed model credentials
door grants, the outbox and the doors' socket (doors/, outbox/, run/)
connected AI tools: their state, a save point before each change to a tool's settings, the door's launcher and bundles (tools/, bin/)
data.export: backup.export: the person's work as plain files (projects with every version, chats and receipts as history, memory, skills), no credential, database row or authority; importHome brings it into a new, empty home through its api

exemptions.reason: modules and models see credential handles only, but the platform itself seals the person's model keys in the data home, under its vault's master key, until the core has a sealed-secrets store
only the harness is chosen by configuration; the other ports (Environment, Connector, Channel, HostAgent, Documents and the rest) are planned

exemptions.rule: modules only through the composition root
exemptions.reason: platform depends on harness-pi and connector-mail (it loads each only by path, after checking it), exceptions recorded in scripts/structure-exceptions.json
its tests run per package and in CI after pnpm check; the example runs in pnpm check through the how-to

removal.rule: not removable while a surface uses it; replaced by another implementation of the api and Gateway ports, once its UNKNOWN effects are settled

swap: another implementation of the api port (src/api.ts) and the Gateway port (src/gateway.ts) over the same core crossings
